sn17.28:1.3: lābhasakkārasiloko bhikkhave chaviṃ chindati, chaviṃ chetvā maṃsaṃ chindati, maṃsaṃ chetvā cammaṃ chindati, cammaṃ chetvā nahāruṃ chindati, nahāruṃ chetvā aṭṭhiṃ chindati, aṭṭhiṃ chetvā aṭṭhimiñjaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati.
sn17.28:1.5: uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma …pe… evaṃ hi kho bhikkhave, sikkhitabbanti.
